mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test (instructor_id, course_id, title, start_date, end_date, test_time, total_score) VALUES ( #{instructorId}, #{courseId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{testTime}, #{totalScore} )
INSERT INTO test_question (test_id, title, question_type, question_no, score, correct_answer) VALUES (#{testId}, #{title}, #{questionType}, #{questionNo}, #{score}, #{correctAnswer});
INSERT INTO test_option (question_id, option_no, content, is_correct) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{optionNo}, #{content}, #{isCorrect})
mapper.select: SELECT e.user_id FROM learner_enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE c.name = #{courseName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_submission (test_id, learner_id, submission_time, submission_status) VALUES (#{testId}, #{learnerId}, #{submissionTime}, #{submissionStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT id, instructor_id, course_id, title, start_date, end_date, test_time, total_score FROM test WHERE id = #{testId}
SELECT id, test_id, title, question_type, question_no, score, correct_answer FROM test_question WHERE test_id = #{testId}
SELECT id, question_id, option_no, content, is_correct FROM test_option WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
